PM2.5.description: Particulate Matter < 2.5 microns. High values are possible but must be bounded by physical diffusion limits. High wind speeds should logically reduce local concentrations.

SoilMoisture.description: Volumetric water content percentage. Significant increases are generally only physically plausible during or immediately after precipitation events.

Temperature.description: Ambient air temperature. Uses diurnal expectations to flag anomalies that deviate from typical hourly patterns.

RelativeHumidity.description: Percentage of moisture in the air. Rapid changes are often sensor errors unless accompanied by rain.
